errors.description: Model incorrectly assumed each color appears only once on a face of a cube, ignoring the actual 2×3×2 grid structure with 8 remaining cubes and their color distribution.
errors.evidence_quote: Model trace: 'each color appears only once on a face of the cube... no color appears more often than the others.'

errors.description: Model failed to perceive multiple cubes of the same color (especially green, which appears 4 times) in the 3D structure, treating it as a single-face color assignment instead of a multi-cube assembly.
errors.evidence_quote: Model trace: 'The blue cube is on the top face... green cube is on the left face...' — implying one cube per color.

analysis_result.analysis: The model fundamentally misunderstood the structure as a single-colored-face cube rather than a 3D grid of 8 colored cubes. It missed the presence of multiple cubes per color (especially green appearing 4 times) and incorrectly concluded no color appears more often. This reflects both a perception failure (missing repeated cubes) and a reasoning failure (incorrect counting based on flawed spatial interpretation).
